440	who are already starting to rely more on the DNA issue, but in most of the poskim we see that they
441	do not rely on DNA at all, and they bring reasoning instead. And so, huh?
442	It helps with the check, it helps. So that's it. I wanted to say that for added clarity one could bring DNA,
443	but they said no, even for added clarity they don't rely on it at all. It doesn't matter to me, even if it would help support
444	my ruling, I don't bring DNA at all, they don't bring DNA. So I wanted to write in my responsum
445	in the conclusion: "and for added clarity I permit DNA together with reasoning in the way of the Torah."
446	I retracted, I retracted, and I said: no, I permit based on reasoning in the way of the Torah,
447	with DNA as an addition.
448	Is there a difference?
449	Certainly.
450	There was a man who came to his rabbi and said, Rabbi, when I study Torah, may I smoke?
451	The rabbi told him no, you may not smoke, no, when you study Torah you don't smoke.
452	He went to his friend and said, listen, I asked the rabbi, and the rabbi said that when you study Torah you don't smoke.
453	He said to him, why are you like that, you don't know how to ask, come with me.
454	He went to the rabbi and said, Rabbi, when I smoke, may I study Torah?
455	He said to him, of course, when you smoke you may study Torah, but when you study Torah you may not smoke.
456	Is there a difference?
457	It depends on how you present it, it depends on how you present it.
458	When you study Torah you can't smoke, but when you smoke you can study Torah. Why not?
459	It's permitted, no problem with it. What's the point?
460	It depends on how you phrase it. Here too, at first I wrote that I permit DNA
461	and in addition reasoning of the Torah in the way of the Torah, and then I retracted and said: no, I permit based on reasoning in the way
462	of the Torah, and for added clarity one can add the DNA. What do you say?
463	Moshe, did you roll one today, some cigarette?
464	Did you roll or didn't you roll?
465	What is this, what, what, what?
466	And they open your closet and see everything arranged, the cigarettes, everything with rolling papers, everything
467	in order.
468	What, what, what?
469	A potato.
470	Both selling and playing innocent.
471	It's as if they sell shoes and the like.
472	As if.
473	Behind the curtain are the real things.
474	Huh?
475	That's it.
476	Anyway, gentlemen, this is truly an interesting question.
477	By the way, if there are identical twins, it's impossible to test who the father is.
478	That is, if I have, say, a twin identical to me, and they test me with his children, and test
479	my children with his children, it all comes out that our children are all the same children. Why?
